name: Economics and Business Administration
summary: The standard Danish business economics degree taught in English: how a company's activities can be analysed and managed so they create value, and how to build strategies for growth. All teaching and all reading is in English because the programme is built around international business. It is a broad degree and the usual route into AU's business master's programmes.
